    pref_pow_sum[0] = 1  # include s[0]^0 = 1

    ans = 0
    for r in range(1, N + 1):
        for i in range(K + 1):
            coeff = C[K][i]
            if (K - i) & 1:
                coeff = MOD - coeff
            term = coeff * pow_s[r][i] % MOD * pref_pow_sum[K - i] % MOD
            ans = (ans + term) % MOD

        # update cumulative sums with current prefix s[r]
        for t in range(K + 1):
            pref_pow_sum[t] = (pref_pow_sum[t] + pow_s[r][t]) % MOD

    print(ans % MOD)
